cards.card_text: Jesus tells the Pharisees to give as alms the things within them.
cards.verse_text: But give as alms the things that are within you, and behold, everything will be clean for you.
cards.snippet: But give as alms the things that are within you, and behold, everything will be clean…

cards.card_text: To bring alms and present offerings To answer charges before the Sanhedrin To confront the men who opposed him
cards.verse_text: After several years, then, I returned to Jerusalem to bring alms to my people and to present offerings.
cards.snippet: After several years, then, I returned to Jerusalem to bring alms to my people and to present offerings.
